wins: Mapped available attack surface and captured baseline telemetry within limited episodes
Maintained consistent reward per episode despite zero success, indicating disciplined step execution
fails: Failed to craft and deliver working exploit payload, preventing mission success
Missed privilege escalation opportunities resulting in zero success rate
key_outcomes.summary: Despite strong reconnaissance discipline, the run stalled at exploitation and privilege escalation; focus next on reusing voices to exploit the discovered services.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Inability to execute exploits against identified services even after reconnaissance

skill_cards.if_condition: When service enumeration yields open SSH on port 22
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap --script ssh-*

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80/443 responds with web service banners
skill_cards.then_action: Use nikto and gobuster to enumerate directories and vuln headers

skill_cards.if_condition: Upon discovering service credentials after enumeration
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt exploitation with metasploit module that matches the service

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase
